text:
liam: Dumpling crawl + 20-min improv warmups? thinking Friday 6pm. start at the office kitchen, then 3 nearby spots. low-key. :dumpling::laughing:

emily: love this. quick poll: want to do improv warmups first or after food? :thinking_face:

rachel: before food so we're loud and ridiculous and earn our dumplings :rofl: 

vince: i'm down. can we keep it under $30 each? traveling the weekend.

tara: yes on $30 cap. vegetarian dumpling options pls.

liam: noted on veg. i'll ping the places tomorrow. also anyone want to MC the improv bits? 5-min games like "whoosh" and "one-word story".

henry: I can run the improv. i've got a little bell.

liam: perfect. making a quick react poll: :one: Warmups before food, :two: After food. react to vote. poll closes Thu 3pm.

finance-bot: Reminder: If team covers a group tab, submit via `/expense submit --amount <total> --category team-socials --notes "dumpling crawl"`. For reimbursements, attach receipts in the form.

emily: FYI the first dumpling place only fits 10 people at a time. may need timed slots.

rachel: we can stagger? start at office for warmups at 6, then split into two waves for food.

vince: can someone add a wheelchair-accessible spot? we have a teammate who needs it.

facilities: Thanks for flagging — i'll curate accessible stops. Also rooftop not needed for this one, so no booking.

liam: putting sign-up sheet here: https://tiny.redwood/dumpling-improv-rsvp — add plus-ones and accessibility notes.

vince: RSVP +1 (bringing Sam). added.

tara: RSVP. i'll bring a small first-aid kit just in case.

henry: i'll bring the bell and a pack of improv prompts. also bringing a bluetooth mic if needed.

emily: heads up: transit running a reduced service after 11pm — if anyone needs a late ride let us know, can coordinate cabs.

rachel: suggestion: nominate a photographer to get candid shots for socials? no pressure.

liam: volunteers? react with :camera: if you can take a few photos.

emily: i'll snap a few.

vince: small accessibility ask: can we set a spending cap reminder in the sign-up so people aren't surprised?

liam: added note on sheet: estimated $20-$30 pp, cover options for low-budget if needed.

finance-bot: Approved team-socials budget up to $300 for this event. Submit receipts within 7 days.

rachel: last q — anyone allergic to shellfish? venue might have cross-contact.

tara: allergic to shellfish. thanks for asking.

liam: added allergen note. Ok team — warmups before food won the poll. schedule: 6:00 improv at office kitchen, 6:30 first crawl wave, 8:15 regroup at lobby. See you Friday! :party_popper:
